Session Closeout

Wrap up a chat session cleanly.

What it does

Produces a skim-ready session summary - what got done, pending manual tasks, and remaining in-chat work - and, on request, a single one-click handoff prompt to continue in a new chat.

When to use it

Ending or wrapping up a working session, especially before continuing the work in a fresh chat.

How to trigger it

"end chat"

"wrap up"

"close out"
